name: Website Build Verification
description: Build the site, open the real page in the shared Browser session, and finish only after visible content, console, network, and a screenshot are checked.

permissionsRequired.reason: Run the project build and report its output.
Open the built page in the shared Browser session.
Read console errors and failed requests on that page.
Confirm the URL, viewport, and screenshot id.
See whether the preview URL responds. This is not UI proof.
Start the preview process when the project needs one.

validation.rule: Completion cites the build output plus a browser_screenshot and browser_console_errors from the opened page. A started process or an HTTP response alone is not full verification.
